name: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
summary: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure is the opening step of a multi-part treasure hunt along the coast of Westfall. Triggered by a battered parchment map, it sends treasure-seekers scouring the shoreline for the late captain's personal footlocker. Finding the buried locker sets off a pursuit across the region for his hidden plunder.

sections.title: A Sailor's Last Bequest
sections.body: The sea off Westfall's western coast is littered with shipwrecks, shattered hulls, and the restless spirits of drowned sailors. Among those lost to the depths was Captain Sanders, an old seafarer who met a watery grave. Rather than letting his hard-won fortune be lost to the Great Sea or stolen outright by scavengers, the old salt penned a series of cryptic instructions, leaving behind a trail that only a determined adventurer could retrace.

sections.title: The Rusty Anchor
sections.body: The first step of the hunt directs the finder toward a lone rusted anchor resting in the surf on the western coast. Hidden half-buried in the sand near a wreck, the captain's old footlocker has survived the battering waves. Inside lies not gold, but seawater, sand, and an unexpected guardian: a scurrying crab clutching the next piece of Sanders' puzzle.

faq.answer: Captain Sanders was a mariner whose vessel wrecked along the treacherous shores of Westfall. Knowing he was doomed to a watery grave, he left behind a map and a series of clues leading to his hidden plunder.

The footlocker is half-buried in the sand along the western coast of Westfall. While many shipwrecks line the beaches, Sanders noted that it lies near a distinctive, solitary rusty anchor resting near the shoreline.

faq.q: Does the footlocker contain the captain's treasure?
faq.answer: The map directs you toward a footlocker and the next clue in a longer treasure hunt.

faq.q: How many clues are in Captain Sanders' treasure hunt?
faq.answer: The hunt spans four steps across the coast and countryside of Westfall, beginning with the map and culminating in the recovery of Captain Sanders' actual buried treasure chest.

faq.q: Why did Captain Sanders bury his treasure in Westfall?
faq.answer: Sanders wrecked his vessel off the coast of Westfall. Faced with impending death, the captain hid his chest and split the clues across familiar coastal landmarks so that a worthy finder could salvage his worldly goods.

faq.q: Can Horde players follow this treasure map?
faq.answer: Yes. Captain Sanders' map and the subsequent clues are neutral, allowing any adventurer who washes up on the coast or braves the shores of Westfall to follow his trail.

angles.text: A pirate's treasure hunt is second nature to scoundrels and privateers who know the value of following a dead sailor's map along a lawless coast.
Westfall's coast is fraught with coastal murlocs and wreckage, making any recovery of sea-bound fortune a small victory amidst the kingdom's frontier turmoil.
